messages:
Alex Chen: Quick q — I just had a foster placement (temporary) and need to add the child to benefits. What counts as a qualifying event for this, and what docs do you need? TL;DR on timing and whether we can get retro coverage?
Maria Gomez: Congrats / thanks for the heads up. Temporary foster placements are a QLE — you can add the child within 30 days of placement. We need proof of placement from the agency or county caseworker. Short list below.
Alex Chen: Awesome. What exactly is acceptable proof? I don’t have a court order, this is an emergency placement.
Maria Gomez: Acceptable: agency placement letter, caseworker email on letterhead, or a foster placement form. If it's emergency, an intake/placement notice from the agency is fine. Please make sure it includes child name, placement date, and agency contact.
Ben Park: Also — will payroll retro deductions apply? If coverage is effective from placement date, how does payroll handle premiums?
Maria Gomez: Good Q. Coverage can be effective back to the placement date if you submit within 30 days. Payroll will prorate premiums back to that effective date. Example: placement on 3/1, you submit 3/20, payroll will deduct the prorated premium starting next payroll cycle.
Alex Chen: Do I need the child’s SSN to enroll? SSN is pending from the agency.
Maria Gomez: Not required at enrollment—SSN can be added later. We can provisionally enroll without SSN but upload a follow-up doc when you have it. We do need the placement proof immediately.
Jess Patel: For HSA/FSA implications — does the dependent count immediately for FSA dependent care?
Maria Gomez: HSA/medical eligibility: child is eligible for medical coverage immediately. For dependent care FSA, eligibility rules differ; foster placements often aren’t eligible for dependent care FSA unless the child meets IRS dependency rules — we recommend checking with the FSA carrier. I can loop in benefits admin if you want.
Alex Chen: Yes please loop them in. Also where do I upload docs?
Maria Gomez: Upload via the benefits portal: https://benefits.redwood.example/upload (choose "Add dependent - QLE"). If you prefer, reply here and I’ll open a ticket and upload for you. Please include a scanned placement letter or screenshot of agency email and the child’s name.
Alex Chen: Uploaded the placement letter just now (file name: placement_032024.pdf). Thanks!
People Ops Bot: Ticket #BP-4517 created for Alex Chen — People Ops will review within 2 business days. Status will appear in the portal. :white_check_mark:
Maria Gomez: Got it — I see the doc. I’ll process the enrollment today. Coverage effective date set to placement date per document. You should see confirmation email and payroll note by EOD. If we need anything else I’ll ping you.
Alex Chen: Fantastic, thank you! :heart:
Ben Park: Thanks Maria. Good to know how this flows for managers too.
Maria Gomez: Anytime — reach out if anything changes or if the placement becomes permanent (different documentation for adoption/finalization).
